瞅.def: to see, to look at, to gaze at

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 秋 (autumn) as the sound: a later character for to look, to glance.

瞅.name: glance

origin.says: Simplified from 瀉: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 写 (write) as the sound: water pouring out, hence to leak and diarrhea.

ety.hint: Lush 丰 and sexy 色

origin.says: From 艷: 豐 (abundant) plus 色 (colour): rich, full colour, hence gorgeous, glamorous. The simplified form replaces 豐 with 丰 (lush).
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 非 as the sound: a fragrant, lush plant; today used for its sound in names like the Philippines.
忄 (heart) for the meaning plus a shortened 楞 (edge) as the sound, with its 木 (tree) dropped: dazed, blank-minded. A late character.
虫 (insect, small creature) for the meaning plus 咼 (crooked mouth) as the sound: the snail. Simplified from 蝸 with 呙.
From 銹, a popular form of 鏽: 金 (metal), shortened to 钅, plus 秀 (bloom) as the sound, replacing 肅: what grows on metal, rust.

沸.def: to boil, to bubble up, to gush

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 弗 (not) as the sound: water bubbling up, boiling.

沸.name: bubbling water

蕴.def: to collect, to gather, to store; profound

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 缊 (tangled hemp) as the sound: to pile up, to store inside. Simplified from 蘊 by writing 糹 as 纟.

蕴.name: store within

逾.def: to jump over; to exceed, to surpass

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 俞 (yes; a dugout boat) as the sound: to go beyond, to exceed. It also stands for the variant 踰 (leap over).

逾.name: overstep

origin.says: ⺝ (flesh) for the meaning plus a shortened 高 (tall) as the sound: animal fat, then any grease, paste or ointment.

沐.def: to bathe, to cleanse, to shampoo, to wash

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 木 (tree) as the sound: to wash the hair, to bathe.

沐.name: hair wash

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 半 (half) as the sound: to mix things together by hand.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus a shortened 隋 (a dynasty name), its 左 and 月 left, as the sound: a heart that hangs slack, lazy.

窜.def: to run away; to expel; to revise, to edit

ety.hint: Simplified form of 竄; a mouse 鼠 running out of its hole 穴

origin.says: Simplified from 竄: 鼠 (mouse) under 穴 (hole), a mouse scurrying in and out of its hole, to flee. The mouse was replaced by 串 (string), which gives the sound.

窜.name: scurry

origin.says: 行 (road, going) for the meaning plus 吾 (I) as the sound, set inside 行: a government office, an official's hall.
𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus a sound part: to leap. The full form 踴 had 勇 (brave) as the sound; the simplified form drops its 力 (strength) and keeps 甬 (bell).

幢.def: carriage curtain; sun screen; tent; measure word for buildings

origin.says: 巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 童 (child) as the sound: a cloth curtain or banner, later a measure word for buildings.

幢.name: hanging banner

湛.def: calm, clear, deep (as of a lake)

ety.hint: A deep 甚 lake 氵; 甚 also provides the pronunciation
Of equal 匀 tone 音; 匀 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 音 (sound) for the meaning plus 匀 (even) as the sound: sounds that match evenly, rhyme. An old variant of 韻, which had 員 (member) as the sound.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 是 (this) as the sound: a bank of earth that holds back water, a dike.
公 (public) as the sound plus 羽 (feathers) for the meaning: first neck feathers, later used for 'old man', helped by 公 (elder, duke).
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 雷 (thunder) as the sound: a flower bud.

ety.hint: Bamboo-like ⺮ tendons in the chest 肋

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) plus 月 (flesh) and 刀 (knife), the knife now written 力 (strength): flesh that is fibrous like peeled bamboo, sinew, tendon.

伺.def: to serve, to wait upon, to attend; to examine

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 司 (manage) as the sound: a person standing by to serve, to wait on, also to watch for.

伺.name: attend

origin.says: 饣 (food) for the meaning plus 交 (to cross) as the sound: a late-made character for stuffed dumplings. Simplified from 餃 by writing 食 (food) as 饣.

梗.def: stem, branch; to hinder, to block

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 更 (change) as the sound: a thorny plant, then a stalk or stem; from that, to block.

梗.name: stem

ety.hint: Elegant 彦 words 讠; 彦 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 彦 (accomplished man) as the sound: a common saying, a proverb. Simplified from 諺.
Simplified from 饞: 飠 (food) for the meaning plus 毚 (a crafty hare) as the sound: greedy for food. 毚 was cut down to a cursive shape and 飠 became 饣.

藐.def: to despise, to disdain; to disregard, to slight

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 貌 (appearance) as the sound: first a plant name; 'small, to look down on, to despise' is a borrowed use.
origin.src: Wiktionary; own knowledge for the meaning shift

藐.name: slight

瑕.def: fault, default; a flaw in a gem

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 复 (return) as the sound: the fleshy part of the body, the belly.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 每 (every) as the sound: the plum (Japanese apricot) tree.
微 (tiny) cut short as the sound, with 糸 (silk) set in its middle for the meaning: a cord or banner worn as a mark; now a badge or emblem.
登 (climb) as the sound over 几 (small table, stool) for the meaning: a bench or stool, something you step up onto.
车 (cart) for the meaning plus 由 (from, pass through) as the sound: the axle that passes through a cartwheel. Simplified from 軸 with the short cart form.
艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 汒 (vast water) as the sound: a boundless stretch, vague and blurry.
芻 (fodder) as the sound plus 皮 (skin) for the meaning: creased skin, wrinkles. Simplified from 皺 by writing 芻 (fodder) as 刍.
A variant of 皁, itself a variant of 早 (early) in its first sense 'acorn': acorn cups gave black dye, hence black, then soap. The modern shape is read as 白 (white) over 七 (seven).
犭 (beast) for the meaning plus 星 (star) as the sound: an ape such as the orangutan.

ety.hint: A red pellet 丶 from a mine 井

origin.says: A mine shaft or well with a dot of cinnabar inside: the red mineral, hence red, and a pill made from it.
牛 (cattle) plus a mark that early forms show as a male sign, later written 土 (earth): a male animal.

诡.def: to cheat, to defraud; sly, treacherous

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 危 (danger) as the sound: deceitful talk, sly, treacherous. Simplified from 詭 by the short speech radical.

诡.name: sly trick

origin.says: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 屯 as the sound: a metal blade that does not cut, blunt; hence dull-witted. Simplified from 鈍.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus a shortened 疏 (sparse) as the sound: a wooden comb with widely spaced teeth.

魄.def: vigor, soul, body; the dark side of the moon

origin.says: 白 (white) as the sound plus 鬼 (ghost) for the meaning: the bodily soul, then vigour.

魄.name: vigour

坊.def: neighborhood, district, community; street, lane; mill

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 方 (square) as the sound: a walled city quarter, a lane; also a workshop or mill.

坊.name: workshop

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 市 (market) as the sound: the persimmon tree. It was first written 柹 with another sound part that looked alike.
身 (body) for the meaning plus 区 (district) as the sound: the body, the trunk. Simplified from 軀 by the shorthand 区.

ety.hint: A person, crouched 尸 defecating 米; 米 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 尸 (body), also the sound, with dots below for droppings, later written 米 (rice): excrement.
饣 (food) for the meaning plus 尧 (lofty) as the sound: plenty of food, abundant; hence also to spare or forgive. Simplified from 饒, with both the food side and 堯 shortened.

ety.hint: A dangerous 凶 drunk 酉

origin.says: 酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 凶 (fierce) as the sound, which also adds to the meaning: drunk and raging.

憬.def: to rouse, to awaken; to become conscious

榨.def: to press for juice; a juicer; a vegetable

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 窄 (narrow, tight) for the sound and the idea of squeezing: a wooden press, to press out juice or oil.

榨.name: juice press

ety.hint: A fire 夂 burning and giving off smoke

origin.says: A drawing of a window or lattice opening in a wall or roof; once the window sense moved to 窗 (window), it was kept for 'chimney'.

拧.def: screw, wrench; to pinch, to twist, to wring

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 宁 (calm), from 寧, as the sound: to twist or wring with the hand. Simplified from 擰.

拧.name: wring

origin.says: 犭 (dog, beast) for the meaning plus 交 (to cross) as the sound: first a kind of wild dog, then sly, cunning.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 明 (bright) as the sound: a plant budding, a sprout.
犭 (dog, animal) for the meaning plus 骨 (bone) as the sound: sly, cunning like a fox.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 畀 (to give) as the sound: numbness, paralysis.
A picture of a boat, seen from above or the side.

舟.name: canoe
舟.in: 般航船盘搬舰艘艇舶舱舵

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 佥 (all) as the sound: a person who is frugal. Simplified from 儉 by shortening 僉 to 佥.

ety.hint: A mouth 呙 made of water 氵

origin.says: From 渦: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 咼 (crooked mouth) as the sound: a whirlpool. 咼 was simplified to 呙.

秉.def: to grasp, to hold; to maintain, to preside over

ety.hint: A hand 彐 grasping a bundle of grain 禾

origin.says: A hand (又, now like 彐) holding 禾 (grain plant) by the stalk: to grasp, to hold. Compare 兼, a hand holding two plants.

秉.name: hold firm

垮.def: to be defeated, to collapse, to fail

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 夸 (big, boast) as the sound: a wall of earth giving way, to collapse.

垮.name: break down

募.def: to levy, to raise; to recruit; to summon

origin.says: 莫 (do not) as the sound plus 力 (strength) for the meaning: to raise or recruit people, funds, forces.

募.name: recruit
